clue.text: Eccentric on trial, creating legal precedent

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: a trial is a test
a case is an odd or eccentric person, as in 'he's a real case'

explanation.surface: An oddball in the dock ends up setting a precedent in law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eccentric' looks like an anagram signal, but it is a plain synonym: a 'case' is an oddball.
explanation.definitionFit: A test case is a lawsuit whose ruling sets the precedent for later ones.

clue.text: Bath waste's ending in pipe

parts.note: a bath is a tub

indicators.note: the ending of the word waste's is its final letter

explanation.surface: The end of the bath's waste outlet sits in a pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A tube is a hollow cylinder, a synonym for a pipe.

clue.text: Mathematical ratio-plus or minus, would you say?

indicators.note: a question about how something is said marks a word that sounds like another

parts.note: plus and minus are each a sign in arithmetic

explanation.surface: Asking whether a mathematical ratio carries a plus or minus.
explanation.definitionFit: In trigonometry the sine of an angle is the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse.

clue.text: Lizard taking hour to be digested by mammal, a long time

indicators.note: being digested puts the hour piece inside the mammal piece, as if eaten

parts.note: a camel is a mammal
an eon is an immensely long time

explanation.surface: A lizard spends an hour being slowly digested by a large animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A chameleon is a colour-changing lizard.

clue.text: Foreign money invested in crooked casinos in US city

indicators.note: money invested in something is put into it, so the currency goes inside
crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters of casinos are rearranged

parts.note: the franc is a foreign currency

explanation.surface: Overseas cash is sunk into dishonest gambling houses in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crooked' rearranges the gambling houses into the letters either side of the currency.
explanation.definitionFit: San Francisco is a city in California.

clue.text: Swampy area round river in American state

indicators.note: the round and the river are placed in the state's abbreviation

parts.note: Mass. is the short form of Massachusetts
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Describing a swampy patch beside a river in some American state.
explanation.definitionFit: A morass is a bog or marsh.

clue.text: Poet's work being performed in classical theatre

parts.note: an ode is a poem
a show that is on is being performed

explanation.surface: A poem is performed in an ancient Greek theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: An odeon was a roofed hall for music in ancient Greece and Rome.

clue.text: Member of indigenous race given name in a great circle

indicators.note: the name abbreviation goes in the great circle

parts.note: a meridian is a great circle of the earth through the poles

explanation.surface: A tribe member is given a name in a large ceremonial circle.
explanation.definitionFit: Amerindian is a term for a Native American person.

clue.text: Shocking log-jam may be avoided by this action

definitions.text: log-jam may be avoided by this action
definitions.meaning: spreading out start times, as of working hours, prevents a jam of traffic

explanation.walkthrough: Staggered hours spread out commuters so the roads do not jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Astounding news leaves you reeling; offsetting times also prevents congestion.

clue.text: Strip girl appears in large handkerchief

parts.note: a band is a strip of material
Anna is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl taking her clothes off ends up in a big hanky.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandanna is a large coloured kerchief worn on the head or neck.

clue.text: Groups in biology with non-specialist learner excluded

indicators.note: the learner is shut out of the word for non-specialist

parts.note: a general practitioner is a non-specialist
L is a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Biology classes where a beginner without specialism is shut out.
explanation.definitionFit: Genera, the plural of genus, are taxonomic categories above species.

clue.text: Loud row over scientist releasing one monstrous creature

indicators.note: in a down clue the earlier pieces sit over the later

parts.note: F is forte, loud in music
a rank is a row, as of soldiers

indicators.note: letting go of one removes the I from the scientist

parts.note: Einstein was a famous physicist
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Amid noisy argument, a scientist lets loose a monster.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly Frankenstein is the scientist, but the name is popularly given to his creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is commonly used for the monster in Mary Shelley's novel.

clue.text: Distressing tendency to interrupt audience

indicators.note: the tendency breaks into the audience word, sitting inside it

parts.note: an audience is a hearing, as granted by a monarch
a trend is a tendency

explanation.surface: An upsetting habit of breaking in on listeners.
explanation.definitionFit: Heart-rending things cause great sorrow or anguish.

clue.text: Act like lovers in brief encounter? That's risky

definitions.text: Act like lovers in brief encounter?
definitions.meaning: a quick touch before going off again, as lovers might

explanation.walkthrough: Brief Encounter is a classic British film about a doomed love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: A touch-and-go situation is precarious, with success uncertain.

clue.text: Fight over class, the source of power for revolution

definitions.text: the source of power for revolution

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: a mill is an old slang word for a fistfight
a stream is a school class grouped by ability

explanation.surface: A class struggle powers a political revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolution' suggests politics, but it is the turning of a mill wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: A millstream is flowing water that drives a mill wheel round.

clue.text: Present zero at left in statistical graph

indicators.note: placed at the left means written first

parts.note: O looks like zero
to present is to give

explanation.surface: Showing a zero at the left of a statistics chart.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogive is a cumulative frequency curve used in statistics.

clue.text: One errand bungled? I can't understand written instructions

indicators.note: bungling messes something up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone excuses a botched errand by saying they can't follow written instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who cannot read is unable to follow anything written.

clue.text: Run, having special diet? Give over!

parts.note: in cricket an extra is a run not scored off the bat

indicators.note: a special diet is a modified one, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone told to run on a special diet exclaims 'Give over!'
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give over!' is British slang for 'stop it', but here it means hand over; 'special' turns DIET into DITE.
explanation.definitionFit: To extradite is to hand a suspect over to another country.

clue.text: Plant in middle of glebe on church ground

indicators.note: in an across clue the first named piece follows the one it is on

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
land is ground
taken as written

indicators.note: the middle of glebe is its central letter

explanation.surface: A plant growing in the middle of church land.
explanation.walkthrough: A glebe is land belonging to a parish church.
explanation.definitionFit: Celandine is a yellow-flowered wild plant.

clue.text: Couple never meeting novelist

definitions.meaning: from 'never the ... shall meet', an old word for a pair

explanation.definitionFit: Twain is archaic for two, and Mark Twain wrote Tom Sawyer.

clue.text: This cloth may get soiled, mascara stain needing to be shifted

indicators.note: the letters must be moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A chair cover gets stained by mascara that must be removed.
explanation.definitionFit: An antimacassar is a cloth over a chair back to protect it from hair oil.

clue.text: Maiden said to be chaste

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
oral means spoken

explanation.surface: A young woman is reputed to be pure.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral can mean virtuous, especially in sexual conduct.

clue.text: Stack of coins, for 'instance, constituting stake

definitions.meaning: a heap, such as a stack of coins
a post driven into the ground as a foundation

explanation.definitionFit: A pile is a heap and also a heavy post driven in to support a building.

clue.text: Heartless deceiver's easy talk

indicators.note: without its heart the word loses its middle letter

parts.note: a cheat is a deceiver

explanation.surface: A conman's smooth patter.
explanation.definitionFit: Chat is relaxed informal conversation.

clue.text: Dull and formal listener being brought in

indicators.note: the listener is brought into the formal word

parts.note: dry means stiff, unemotional and formal
the ear is the organ of listening

explanation.surface: A dull, stiff person is brought in to listen.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreary means tedious and gloomy.

clue.text: Content of food is bad, very bad

indicators.note: the content of something is what is held inside it

parts.note: a dish is a food
evil means bad

explanation.surface: A complaint that the food is awful.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilish means wicked or fiendish.

clue.text: With appearance of gold, this has combination of metals

definitions.text: With appearance of gold, this has combination of metals

parts.words: With appearance of gold, this has combination of metals
parts.note: a description of a gold-coloured alloy of copper and zinc used for decoration

explanation.definitionFit: Ormolu is gilded bronze or a gold-coloured alloy used on furniture and clocks.

clue.text: Pursuit of profit

definitions.meaning: money earned on a loan or investment

explanation.definitionFit: A hobby is an interest, and interest is also a return on money.
